issue.body:
Hi!

Here is a version bump for `www-apps/gitea`.

Please find attached 3 commits:

* **taking maintainership:** As discussed [here](https://github.com/gentoo/gentoo/pull/10947), [here](https://github.com/gentoo/gentoo/pull/10601),  [here](https://github.com/nemunaire/gentoo-overlay/commit/663269936445ac8964bf4156eca361b71e6b158e#comments) and [here](https://github.com/nemunaire/gentoo-overlay/commit/54a8bc41f9d65c619d059d32ec05573bf4858718#commitcomment-32141171) with @xdch47, we will both co-maintain the ebuild.

* **bump to 1.7.1:** The latest version released is 1.7.1. It includes some cleaning regarding configuration files (`GITEA_WORK_DIR` is now used as working directory instead of `GITEA_CUSTOM`, see [gitea doc](https://docs.gitea.io/en-us/specific-variables/)). Also closes: https://bugs.gentoo.org/671596.

* **remove old:** Old Gitea releases contains security vulnerabilities, so we remove vulnerable ebuild from the tree + do some cleaning with old files. `gitea.logrotated` is not needed anymore as `gitea` include it's own logrotate mechanism. `app.ini` is not used, instead we edit the sample config through `sed` during the ebuild prepare step.

@hydrapolic could you review and give us your feedback?
